== Appearance in the Timeline ==

Part of the July 26th, 1999 - Plane of Fear patch.

<b><font color="green">P99 UPDATE: February 8, 2020</font></b> - this quest is now live on <b><font color="green">Green</font></b>.

'' be careful turning in lightstones to this NPC or vendoring items at lower levels there are aggressive NPC everything from lower level wolves, to higher level griffawns, that would pose a challenge to any new adventurer that path through the area that will attack. ''

<ul><li>  {{:Concordance of Research}}
</li><li> {{:Runes and Research Volume I}}

== Walkthrough ==

'''Faction Note: Dubious will eat your lightstone(s). Suspect apprehensive and above is required. This rules out Iksars from being able to turn in unless using faction tricks like sneak or wolf form.'''

''This quest begins with [[Mrysila]] at location -671, -170 in North Karana.''

You say, 'Hail, Mrysila'

: Mrysila says 'I am Mrysila, custodian of the [Concordance of Research].'

You say, 'What Concordance of Research?'

: Mrysila says 'The 'Concordance of Research' is an aid to those who follow the path of academia.  It, and its sister books, 'Runes and Research,' volumes I and II, help those who are [interested] in researching spells.'

You say, 'I am interested'

: Mrysila says 'I have several copies of each book. If you want a copy of 'Runes and Research', volume I or II, bring me a lightstone and I will give you whichever book I have more of at the moment. Bring me a greater lightstone, and I will give you a copy of the 'Concordance of Research.'

'''Lightstones are a common drop from willowisps.'''

'''Upon handing in a [[Lightstone]]:'''

: Mrysila says 'A lightstone? Thank you very much. Here is a copy of 'Runes and Research.''

Upon handing in a [[Greater Lightstone]]:

: Mrysila says 'A greater lightstone? Thank you very much. Here is a '[[Concordance of Research]]' for you.'
